arcs.title: What the Hollow Gave Back
arcs.summary: New arc to open Saturday or Sunday upon return from Harlan's Hollow. The creek crossing, the unnamed ridge above, whatever Steve finds worth a margin note, what the duck looked like when they arrived — all of it unreported until the Jeep comes home. Day 1 should be the return itself: mud, something new on the chart, and one thing from the hollow that nobody expected.
